card.name: Describing type of neuropathy or myopathy
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside a disease-type descriptor, such as 'an' or 'with' before 'axonal polyneuropathy', or the middle of axonal, demyelinating, necrotizing and subacute. Appears in clinical case descriptions of nerve, muscle or liver disease.

modes.label: Inside type-of-disease words
modes.description: Partway through adjectives like axonal, demyelinating, necrotizing or subacute that classify a neuropathy or myopathy.

modes.label: Linking word before a classification
modes.description: A small word such as 'an', 'with' or 'chronic' right before a disease-type label.

card.plain: It fires while a disease is being classified by type or course, like axonal, demyelinating or progressive.
